arStrings.szText: {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} sends out {c_number}[{SF_16}*2]{/c} additional claws and each set deals {c_number}[{SF_17}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage than the last.

{c_important}Dread Claws{/c} are cast around you, each dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_CIRCLE}{/c} damage. You consume {c_number}{SF_15}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Shadowform{/u}{/c} to also conjure claws around your most recent {c_important}Greater Demon Summon{/c}.

{c_important}Dread Claws{/c} becomes a {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} Skill and is cast in a frontal cone, dealing {c_number}{payload:IMPACT_JAWS}{/c} damage and killing up to {c_number}{SF_12}{/c} {c_important}Lesser Demons{/c} it strikes. Each {c_important}Lesser Demon{/c} killed grants {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} a {c_number}[{SF_7}|+%|]{/c} chance for {c_number}{SF_11}{/c} seconds to {c_important}{u}Eviscerate{/u}{/c} enemies for {c_number}{dot:EVISCERATE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage, up to {c_number}[{SF_12}*{SF_7}|+%|]{/c}.
Every second, gain {c_number}[{SF_18}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage for your next {c_important}Dread Claws{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_18}*{SF_19}*100|x%|]{/c}.
Killing enemies or demons with {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} reduces the cost of your next {c_important}Dread Claws{/c} by {c_number}[{SF_20}*100|%|]{/c}, up to {c_number}[{SF_20}*{SF_21}*100|%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Dread Claws{/c} deals {c_number}[{SF_22}*100|x%|]{/c} increased damage with its first claw strike against each enemy. When attacking from {c_important}{u}Stealth{/u}{/c} all claws gain this bonus.
{c_important}Dread Claws{/c} makes enemies {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} for {c_number}{SF_23}{/c} seconds if it strikes them at least {c_number}{SF_24}{/c} times.
